traits: Confident, but not arrogant (he'll 'make a BET')

voice.status: Draft, inferred from the sales copy. Confirm with Justin.
voice.style_notes: Talks to 'you'. Uses CAPS on one word for emphasis (BET, DOING, OVERTHINKING). Short punchy lines with ellipses for rhythm.

positioning.audience: People who love singing along to their favourite artists (any level, no training needed): content creators, karaoke fans, hobby singers who want to level up.
positioning.unique: Teaches imitation through Justin's listening process (hear what makes a singer unique, then recreate it) instead of theory and exercises.
positioning.onlyness: The only vocal course that teaches you to sing like your favourite artists by first teaching you to hear them like a pro: no theory, no scales.
positioning.core_promise: Sing like your favs, and unlock a voice you never imagined possible.
proof: Real-time breakdowns of Ed Sheeran and Passenger
Bonus vocal analyses: Green Day & Steve Perry
Guarantee: your voice will be unrecognizable
